title: Kernel open-sources GPU-accelerated browser sandbox for agents
summary: Kernel provides open-source browser infrastructure that spins up sandboxed Chromium instances in under 30 ms on GPU-accelerated hardware, aimed at AI agent workloads. Includes session replay for debugging; in production at Framer and Cash App, billed only when active.

research.notes: Founded 2025 by Rafael Garcia and Catherine Jue (YC). Unikernel-per-browser architecture; reports <325 ms cold start vs 3–5 s for container-based equivalents.

web_findings.title: Kernel: Browser infrastructure for web agents and automations
web_findings.snippet: Sandboxed unikernel per browser; MP4 replay; Apache-2.0 infra and SDKs.

web_findings.title: kernel/kernel-images — GitHub
web_findings.snippet: Browsers-as-a-service for automations and web agents.

web_findings.title: Kernel vs Browserbase — Kernel Blog
web_findings.snippet: Reports 5.8× faster cold starts and 50–98% lower cost vs Browserbase.
